Telangana DSP's Properties Raided in Disproportionate Assets Case

The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) in Telangana has conducted raids on the properties of Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP) Bheem Reddy. The raids are reportedly related to a disproportionate assets case. Further details regarding the investigation and findings have not been disclosed.
